name: octaweave_create_label
description: Create a label. You usually do NOT need this — passing a new name in `labels` when creating a note or a card creates it. Use this only to set a specific colour up front.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.
